title: INTEGRATION (Lane A): Provider-simulator e2e reliability tests for health-data sync
description:
Source: `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_INTEGRATION.md`

Goal: Add CI-safe e2e/integration tests for health-data sync reliability scenarios by introducing a provider simulator and wiring adapters to point at it in tests.

Out of scope: live-provider browser OAuth flows / short-lived token automation (documented in the doc’s OUT OF SCOPE section).

features.title: Create provider simulator (HTTP server) for health-data adapters (Lane A)
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_INTEGRATION.md`.

- Implement a lightweight simulator serving deterministic responses for key provider endpoints.
- Support scripting scenarios: success, partial data, pagination/cursor, transient errors.

Acceptance:
- Can be started/stopped from e2e tests.
- Deterministic fixtures checked into repo.

features.title: Wire adapters/config to point to simulator during e2e tests
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_INTEGRATION.md`.

- Add configuration to override base URLs for providers in test environment.
- Ensure no real network calls in CI e2e suite.

Acceptance:
- Tests fail if real-provider domains are called.
- CI-safe and repeatable.

features.title: E2E scenario: happy-path sync (single window) using simulator
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_INTEGRATION.md`.

Acceptance:
- Sync endpoint/job completes successfully.
- Persisted daily + raw + sync-state records match expected fixtures.

features.title: E2E scenario: pagination/cursor progression and resume
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_INTEGRATION.md`.

Acceptance:
- Cursor is advanced correctly across pages.
- Re-running sync resumes from correct point and is idempotent.

features.title: E2E scenario: transient provider failure then success on re-sync
features.description:
Lane A reliability test.

Acceptance:
- First run records a retryable/transient error state.
- Second run (same inputs) succeeds and clears/updates error state appropriately.

features.title: E2E scenario: permanent auth failure classification
features.description:
Lane A reliability test.

Acceptance:
- Auth failure is classified as non-retryable.
- Sync-state reflects correct error category and does not advance cursor.

features.title: E2E scenario: partial data + merge behavior across multiple windows
features.description:
Lane A reliability test.

Acceptance:
- Daily aggregation merge rules are validated end-to-end.
- Missing hours/days do not corrupt existing aggregates.
